div.div: 5 تأبّاهُ He adopted him as a father; (M, K, TA;) as also ↓ استأباهُ ; (M in art. اب;) and so تأبّاهُ أَبًا, accord. to A'Obeyd: (TA:) [or,] accord. to A'Obeyd, you say, تَأَبَّيْتُ أَبًا I adopted a father: (T:) and you say also, اِسْتَأَبَّ أَبًا and اِسْتَأْبَبَ أَبًا he adopted a father. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
